title: Just Juice Bar Range Dragonfruit & Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dragonfruit & Raspberry from Just Juice's Bar Range of Nic Salt e-liquids is a captivating mix of the exotic and the familiar, blending the unique, juicy taste of Dragonfruit with the sharp, sweet tang of Raspberry. This combination creates a vibrant and refreshing flavour profile that's both juicy, rich, tantalising and satisfying, perfect for vapers seeking a taste of the exotic. This premium e-liquid's 60PG/40VG blend is expertly crafted to strike the ideal balance between robust flavour and satisfying cloud production. The use of nic salt formulation makes it perfectly suited for classic e-cigarette starter kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod devices, providing an optimal choice for those new to vaping or looking for the quick, satisfying nicotine hit that nic salts deliver. Nicotine salts offer a smoother throat hit and a faster absorption into the bloodstream than traditional freebase nicotine, delivering almost instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Just Juice's Bar Range particularly appealing for those seeking a potent, yet silky smooth vaping experience. Inspired by the intensely satisfying flavours synonymous with the most popular disposable vapes, the Just Juice Bar Range of Nic Salt E-liquids includes both timeless classics and intriguing new concoctions. All Just Juice e-liquids are designed to be long-lasting, less allergenic, and gentler on the throat, ensuring a premium vaping experience with every puff. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
